description: What the app's merge tests read from GitHub, recorded from the app on generation 3 of fixtures/merge.sh's pull requests, rozed-dev/e2e#138 to #154: #138, ready, its panel opened and stepped through the methods to a squash, which read the commit GitHub would write; #148, blocked by e4/gated's rules, its panel opened and its failed check's run opened; #142, a draft; #151, first in e4/queued's queue, which rozed-bot added it to; #149, waiting for an approval with auto-merge on, which rozed-bot turned on; and #138 again with no account. Each tab stayed open long enough for its polls to repeat.
